term: state variation across indexed episode times
definition: In `StaticEpisodeControl`, state variation is the existence of two indices `t₁,t₂` with `StateAt t₁ ≠ StateAt t₂`. A singleton time carrier admits one occurring episode but no state variation. This is a deliberately weak test, not an account of all time or motion.
note: A countermodel to the invalid inference from one actual episode to temporal succession.
